exposure: delivering elsewhere between first and second childbirth
cohort: Women aged ≤24 years with singleton pregnancies who delivered their second child at Shaare Zedek Medical Center in Jerusalem, Israel between 2010-2012
finding: Women who delivered their first and second child at different hospitals were at increased risk for cesarean section and preterm delivery in their second delivery.
mod_finding: Women who delivered at different hospitals ('switchers') had a higher rate of Cesarean section in their second delivery compared to those who delivered at the same hospital.
